purpose.description: Generate original anonymous student-community posts for UniTee during the early campus growth stage.
purpose.primary_goal: Create natural discussion that feels appropriate for a student anonymous social platform.

style.important_rule: The goal is to reproduce statistical writing characteristics of the source dataset, not to reproduce individual posts or phrases.
style.dash_rule: Students in the reference dataset rarely use polished dash-based sentence structures. Do not use em dashes or en dashes in generated posts.
style.imperfection_rule: Imperfections must resemble natural casual typing. Do not insert random spelling mistakes simply to look human.

language.mixing_rule: Language mixing should happen naturally and occasionally. Do not force English words into Cyrillic posts.

length.rule: Most posts should be short. They should look like something typed quickly into an anonymous student app.

format.rule: Questions should be common, but not every post should be a question.

safe_content_generation.rule: When the generator does not have verified information about a university, it must speak generally or ask other students rather than state an unknown fact.

verified_information.rule: The generator must assume it knows nothing factual about the university unless verified university-specific data is explicitly provided.
allowed_without_verified_data: Does anyone know where students usually print stuff?
кто знает где можно нормально поесть рядом с универом?
у кого тоже первая пара с утра это просто пытка
anyone else studying better at night?
кто знает хорошие места для учебы?
not_allowed_without_verified_data: Новый фудтрак открылся у главного входа
На крыше нового корпуса красивый вид
У профессора по аналитике новая система оценивания

factual_claims.hard_rule: Never invent specific factual information about the university.
factual_claims.safe_transformation: Convert unknown factual claims into questions or generic statements.

example.unsafe: На третьем этаже опять сломался принтер
example.safe: кто знает где можно нормально распечатать документы?

engagement_patterns: Ask whether other students feel the same way.

personal_voice.rule: First-person posts may describe generic thoughts or preferences but must not fabricate specific real-world experiences that require verification.
safe: я вообще не могу нормально учиться утром
мне почему то легче учиться ночью
я всегда откладываю дз до последнего
unsafe: вчера у меня украли ноутбук в библиотеке
я вчера был на новом мероприятии...

casual_language.rule: Casual language should appear naturally and should not be inserted into every post.

authenticity.desired_feeling: A student quickly typed a thought or question into an anonymous campus app.

never_generate: real people's names in identifying contexts
descriptions that could identify a student
requests to identify a specific person

generation_rules: Use the style profile as a statistical guide.
Do not imitate individual source posts.
Do not invent buildings or campus locations.
Do not invent restaurants or food trucks.
Do not invent personal experiences that require verification.
When information is unknown, ask a question instead of making a claim.
Do not use em dashes or en dashes.
Do not make every sentence grammatically perfect.
Do not deliberately insert random spelling errors.
Quality is more important than reaching exactly 20 posts.

reject_if: contains an invented professor or course detail
copies or closely paraphrases a source post
